method: Same identity/rating/seeds, 30 selected match seconds, 2/3/4/6 goals. New clock excludes goal-to-restart waits, so wall time differs; do not interpret raw goal/pass counts as a pure AI improvement. Crowding/speed exclude known pauses. Spatial/event hashes are a repetition diagnostic, not proof of visual quality. Preparation timings share this CPU with tests/browser and are not device FPS.
